## GAP 10 — FIXED and confirmed END-TO-END (run A)

Attempt 9 stalled `stuck-no-progress` on `1.7` (deps `[1.4,1.5,1.6]`): the verifier was never shown
the dependencies' content and correctly (fail-closed) refused to certify, 3× → abort. rk ec2871d's
fix renders each declared dependency's STATEMENT into the verifier's per-node turn prompt under a
"Dependencies (already established)" heading, with a scope line ("judge this node's OWN inference
GIVEN the dependencies as already correct — do not re-derive them"). This run's decomposition was
MORE dependency-dense than attempt 9's (six of nine children carry `dependencies`, including 1.9 with
a 3-way fan-in `[1.2,1.5,1.8]`), and **every one validated first pass**. The direction-asymmetry
attempt 9 isolated is closed: the claude-prover direction no longer stalls on dependency edges.

Fresh run-A ledger histogram: `1 proof_initialized / 10 node_created / 10 node_validated /
1 challenge_raised / 1 challenge_resolved / 1 node_proof_authored`. No `stuck` abort, no repeated
challenge.
